modalLead: Shift+H opens the whole Bookmarks list, and Bookmarks opens sooner.

items.text: Shift+H opens the whole list, the same as the Bookmarks button, instead of only the broken ones. It also works with health checks off.
Bookmarks and Config open sooner the first time: they start loading as soon as you point at their button.
Views open with a shorter fade, so Config, Bookmarks, Inbox and Containers appear without the wait.
